scope: Inspect exact existing original artifact only. No artifact code or binaries are executed.
No fixtures, JVM, Gradle, package installation/download, source runtime checkout, probes, official seed or claim access.
One authenticated API ZIP redirect to HTTPS *.blob.core.windows.net, then unauthenticated request; no further redirects or retries; no signed URL/token output.

Complete original ZIP base64 is framed in contiguous 16384-character chunks; CRC/SHA manifest includes every member. Raw selected JSON/XML/controls/exit/prerequisite metadata are separately base64 framed; log excerpts explicitly remain subsets.

All JSON is strictly parsed within byte/memory limits. Only oversized source-map JSON may be digest/comparison-only text, while its full bytes remain in relayed original ZIP. Other required text over cap stops before relay.
Independent reviewer must reconstruct original bytes and validate all frames/hashes; decoded job-log tool maximum is unknown. Incomplete/truncated relay grants no acceptance.
Derived observations and original workflow success do not constitute full runtime, policy, experiment or gameplay admission. Original raw expected failure remains failure.
Workflow invokes existing /usr/bin/timeout with SIGKILL at300seconds, enclosing Python relay and error writes; missing prerequisite or timeout is a failed readback, with no automatic retry.

validation.hash_method: Pure in-memory ASCII SHA256 helper verified empty/abc/exact original qualifier vectors; immutable Git blobs additionally bind exact source.
